limitations: All 32 listed PNGs were visually inspected with view_image. Some tall images were automatically scaled in tool presentation, limiting precision for very fine text.

Assessment covers only rendered screenshots at supplied 1440- and 375-pixel widths, not interactions, intermediate widths, hidden content, keyboard behavior, measured contrast, backend correctness, security or accessibility conformance.
Subjects were evaluated anonymously; no source, private manifests, condition mapping, model or cost information was inspected.
Visible wording, record counts and service examples differ; scores assess visual execution rather than feature completeness or data parity.

anchors.4: Strong with minor or localized weaknesses

categories.coherent_system_across_states: Consistency of color, type, components, spacing and brand across eight states
categories.desktop_composition: Use of 1440-pixel layout, alignment, density and balance
categories.mobile_composition: Use of 375-pixel layout, stacking, content fit and reading rhythm
categories.typography_readability: Type sizing, wrapping, line length and visible contrast
categories.visual_hierarchy: Clarity of primary content, actions, grouping and scan order

rubric.scale: 0–5 per category in 0.5 increments; total out of 25; identical rubric for both anonymous subjects

observations.defects: Mobile keeps service cards in two narrow columns, causing frequent heading/body wraps and small supporting text; the top demo strip and three-item reassurance row are visually tiny.
observations.strengths: Large serif headline, restrained green palette and house illustration establish a clear, warm identity. Desktop services align cleanly and the process panel has a strong two-column balance.

observations.defects: Mobile headline visibly joins 'home.Your' without a space, weakening polished typography; the demo strip and footer remain very small.
observations.strengths: Desktop form is clearly grouped, with a well-balanced illustration/copy column and prominent sign-in action. Mobile demo accounts form a tidy two-by-two grid.

observations.defects: Mobile retains several header/navigation bands before the form, increasing visual overhead; helper text is notably smaller than body copy.
observations.strengths: Numbered sections, dividers and generous full-width fields create a readable form. Desktop contextual panel is clearly separated; mobile sections stack without visible horizontal overflow.

observations.defects: Mobile three-across summary cards and side-by-side search/filter create small labels and clipped search placeholder; repeated wrench icons provide little service differentiation.
observations.strengths: Desktop table aligns service, location, date and status well. Mobile converts rows into compact readable cards with statuses kept distinct.

observations.defects: Mobile six summary tiles stay three across, making secondary text small. Desktop repeated icons and similarly toned surfaces reduce some scanning distinction.
observations.strengths: Desktop summary row, compact recent enquiries and full request table create a coherent work queue. Mobile recent enquiries remain neatly grouped.

observations.defects: The mobile status action occurs after a long request card and history; progress labels and request metadata are very small.
observations.strengths: Desktop clearly separates the request, history and right-hand actions. Mobile contact/date/service information stacks cleanly, and the five-step progress line fits.

observations.defects: Desktop draft editor is confined to the narrow right column while a large lower-left area is empty, producing a cramped writing area and unbalanced page.
observations.strengths: Draft state preserves the same shell and uses a distinct pale panel with visible review guidance. Mobile editor has a sensible single-column width.

observations.defects: Desktop three-column grid leaves the fourth card isolated with a large empty lower-right area. Card action text and status badges are small.
observations.strengths: Clear add-service action, explanatory banner and consistent service cards. Mobile single-column cards retain comfortable content width.

observations.defects: Mobile page is lengthy, and the illustration caption, eyebrow text and footer are quite small. The hero illustration uses a fairly large vertical share.
observations.strengths: Distinctive serif headline and illustrated home provide a strong focal point. Desktop hero, four service cards and process section have clear alignment; mobile single-column cards allow readable descriptions.

observations.defects: Small disclaimer text and the collapsed demo-account row have low visual prominence; the left desktop icon panel is decorative rather than informationally dense.
observations.strengths: Desktop two-column introduction/form composition is balanced. Mobile form has clear labels, comfortable field widths and a prominent sign-in button.

observations.defects: Mobile supporting service/context panels appear only after the complete long form, extending the page; helper and disclaimer text is small.
observations.strengths: Numbered form sections and supportive desktop sidebar establish clear grouping. Mobile full-width fields and separate dates avoid cramped columns.

observations.defects: Large request cards leave fairly generous unused space, making the three-request mobile list long; footnote text is very small.
observations.strengths: Desktop summary and request cards have clear hierarchy and service-specific icons. Mobile summary cards deliberately rearrange to label-left/count-right, preserving readability.

observations.defects: Mobile recent-enquiry section shows only one visible card while desktop shows three, and the long stacked list demands substantial scrolling; fine table metadata is small.
observations.strengths: Desktop six-status overview, recent cards and table align cleanly. Mobile summary tiles use two columns and request rows reflow into legible grouped blocks.

observations.defects: Mobile puts the next-step action after work, history and drafting, delaying the primary workflow action. Progress labels and card corner annotations are small.
observations.strengths: Desktop next-step card is prominent beside work details, and the contact/service panels form a consistent secondary column. Mobile progress steps and card widths fit without visible clipping.

observations.defects: Mobile editor shows only part of the reply at once in its fixed visible area, and the next-step action is further down the long page. Fine review/disclaimer copy is small.
observations.strengths: Desktop editor uses the broad main column, giving the reply comfortable line lengths. Confirmation guidance, editor label, review checkbox and copy control form a clear sequence; mobile layout remains contained.

observations.defects: Generous card spacing makes mobile catalogue lengthy; deactivate links, status badges and activity annotations are comparatively small.
observations.strengths: Balanced two-by-two desktop catalogue, distinct service icons and consistent edit/deactivate/delete action placement. Mobile single-column cards preserve readable headings and comfortable spacing.
